text:
pkg-eng: Packaging ready for staging -> airgap cutover. uploading shrinkwrap private-installer v1.6.0-beta to staging-bucket now. will run cosign after upload.

ethan: ETA for checksum publish?

pkg-eng: ~10m for upload, cosign immediately after. need security sign-off to test key rotation (sigstore-prod-key-02).

sre-ops: Any DB migrations or schema changes? ops needs to know if we need a maintenance window.

lisa: No DB work. Just daemonset image updates and a nodeSelector tweak for GPU pools (nvidia-driver=470). No downtime expected.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: private-installer:v1.6.0-beta -> staging (staging-cluster) at 1969998780. estimated 12m.

marie: Can we pin container runtime versions in the bundle? last release had runtime diffs that messed with checksums.

pkg-eng: Done. containerd=1.7.1, runc=1.1.4 pinned in the installer manifest and noted in release metadata.

oss-ci-bot: CI artifacts uploaded: sha256:abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890. cosign sig attached: cosign.sig (key: sigstore-prod-key-02).

jasper: We should also create an explicit rollback artifact tag: private-installer:v1.6.0-beta-rollback -> points to v1.5.9-stable snapshot. keeps rollback fast.

sre-ops: Canary plan: push to 3 customer VPCs in eu-west1 (canary cohort A), monitor for 30m, if error-rate > 5% across control metrics roll back. Fallback: v1.5.9-stable.

ethan: Monitoring targets: token throughput, kv-cache miss rate, grpc error 5xx, p95 latency. Will wire dashboards and alerts. Runbook link: https://intranet.redwood/ops/runbooks/airgap-deploy

lisa: :thumbsup: I’ll be on call during the window. Immediate rollback command: `pkg-eng rollback --tag v1.5.9-stable --scope canary`

pkg-eng: After canary + sign-off we push the final airgap bundles to production mirrors and update the delivery manifest. I’ll draft release notes post-merge.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded to staging at 1969998798.

oss-ci-bot: checksum replication to mirrors started (replica-set: eu-west, us-west, ap-south).

marie: I’ll add cosign verification instructions to the release notes and include troubleshooting for customers doing local verification.

pkg-eng: All set for cutover window at 02:00 UTC tomorrow. Final checks: cosign present, runtimes pinned, rollback tag exists, canary cohort defined.

sre-ops: Acknowledged. Will open incident channel at cutover start and post live metrics.

jasper: +1. If anything looks off we trigger rollback and notify affected customers.

marie: Draft release notes saved: `/docs/release-notes/private/v1.6.0-beta.md` — will finalize after production push.

oss-ci-bot: replication completed to eu-west and us-west at 1969998815; ap-south pending.

pkg-eng: Thanks team. Posting final checklist in the channel 15m before cutover.
